paragraph: [The Banco Nacional de Angola launched Kwik in June 2023](<https://www.expansao.co.ao/angola/detalhe/movimentos-entre-carteiras-digitais-valem-apenas-06-no-kwik-74789.html>). It carries instant transfers between banks and digital wallets. [In February 2026 KWiK handled 3.14 million transfers worth Kz 74.6 billion](<https://angop.ao/noticias/economia/paypay-ultrapassa-1-6-milhoes-de-transferencias-mensais-no-kwik/>), EMIS reported. [In the first half of 2026 wallets sent Kz 209.6bn to bank accounts over Kwik](<https://www.expansao.co.ao/angola/detalhe/movimentos-entre-carteiras-digitais-valem-apenas-06-no-kwik-74789.html>). [Digital wallets sent Kz 212.7bn of the Kz 557.4bn moved over Kwik in the first half of 2026](<https://www.expansao.co.ao/angola/detalhe/movimentos-entre-carteiras-digitais-valem-apenas-06-no-kwik-74789.html>), Expansão reports from EMIS data. No change has been found in the last twelve months.

[BurundiPay, the national instant payment system run by the BRB, had about 224,000 users on 4 August 2026](<https://www.jimberemag.org/une-revolution-de-leconomie-digitale-au-burundi/>). [On BurundiPay 17 institutions (5 commercial banks, 10 microfinance institutions, 2 payment institutions) are live, per the BRB](<https://www.jimberemag.org/une-revolution-de-leconomie-digitale-au-burundi/>). [The BRB says BurundiPay already allows exchanges between banks, microfinance institutions and mobile wallets locally](<https://www.brb.bi/node/3303>). In the last twelve months, [Burundi Pay, the national instant payment system, has been operational since March 2026, per the central bank's deputy governor](<https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/news/east-africa/burundi-to-join-east-african-payment-network-by-december-2026-5562616>).

[The BCEAO launched PI-SPI, its regional instant payment platform, on 30 September 2025](<https://lanation.bj/economie/lancement-du-systeme-de-paiement-instantane-interoperable-la-pi-spi-une-solution-rapide-et-inclusive-au-profit-des-citoyens-uemoa>). [Bank transfers can credit mobile money wallets in seconds through it, and the reverse](<https://www.lanation.bj/numerique/plateforme-interoperable-du-systeme-de-paiement-instantane-banques-et-mobile-money-desormais-interconnectes-a-100-dans-luemoa>). [At 31 July 2026 nine of Benin's 15 banks and financial establishments were connected, with Moov Money and MTN, two of its three mobile money issuers](<https://lamarina.bj/2026/08/14/marche-beninois-du-pi-spi-qui-manque-encore-a-lappel-du-paiement-instantane-de-la-bceao/>). In the last twelve months, wallet and bank transfers began to route through PI-SPI. [From 2 November 2026 MTN, Moov Money and UBA Benin route transfers between wallets, other operators and banks through PI-SPI](<https://triomphemag.com/interoperabilite-du-mobile-money-au-benin-pi-spi-entre-en-vigueur-ce-qui-change-reellement-pour-les-utilisateurs-des-ce-2-novembre/>). No source found since October 2023 says a national switch connects wallets and bank accounts. Mature would need a national switch in service that connects mobile money wallets and bank accounts.

[In September 2026 Orange said Max It is interconnected with almost all the country's banks for transfers between bank accounts and Orange Money](<https://burkina24.com/2026/09/21/orange-burkina-faso-lance-la-nouvelle-version-de-son-application-max-it/>). [The BCEAO's PI-SPI instant payment platform, launched on 30 September 2025, connects banks, e-money institutions and payment institutions](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article147670>). [In July 2026 Wave Burkina said traders, farmers and young entrepreneurs use its service for payment, money transfer and savings](<https://web.archive.org/web/20260729074730/https://www.aib.media/guiriko-lanpfi-et-wave-burkina-lancent-une-campagne-de-formation-au-profit-des-consommateurs-des-services-financiers/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a national switch connects wallets and bank accounts. Mature would need a national switch in service that connects mobile money wallets and bank accounts.

[In September 2026 Orange Money, Mascom's MyZaka and BTC's Smega operated as mobile money platforms](<https://www.mmegi.bw/business/fnbb-muscles-into-mobile-money-race/news>) in Botswana. [In March 2025 mobile money in Botswana was interoperable with bank accounts](<https://thevoicebw.com/mobile-money-madness/>). In the last twelve months, [in August 2026 Mukuru launched a Visa-branded card linked to its Mukuru Wallet](<https://www.connectingafrica.com/fintech/mukuru-launches-mobile-wallet-linked-visa-card-in-botswana>). [In November 2026 Mukuru said customers can withdraw PayPal funds into the wallet](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/11/26/mukuru-partners-paypal-direct-withdrawals-wallets-botswana/>). No source found since October 2023 says a national switch connects wallets and bank accounts. Mature would need a national switch in service that connects mobile money wallets and bank accounts.

[The CEMAC QR Code standard was launched on 29 July 2026 across six states including the Central African Republic](<https://leconomie.info/article/paiement-numerique-le-gimac-officialise-la-norme-qr-code-interoperable-de-la-cemac>). It lets a client with a bank account, mobile money wallet or microfinance account pay by scan whatever their institution. [AfricaNenda says GIMACPAY also provides domestic instant payment functionality connecting banks and mobile money wallets in each CEMAC state](<https://www.africanenda.org/uploads/files/SIIPS2023_CaseStudy_CEMAC.pdf>). That includes the Central African Republic. [Telecel Money mobile money is in service in the Central African Republic, according to Telecel and ENERCA](<https://oubanguimedias.com/2026/08/07/centrafrique-telecel-et-enerca-signent-un-partenariat-pour-digitaliser-le-paiement-des-factures-delectricite/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months.

PI-SPI, which the BCEAO launched on 30 September 2025, [carries instant transfers between bank accounts, wallets and microfinance accounts](<https://www.fratmat.info/article/2641755/economie/uemoa-linteroperabilite-des-paiements-devient-obligatoire-des-le-30-juin-2026>). In the last twelve months, [from 2 November 2026 transfers between e-money providers, and between banks and wallets, must route through it](<https://launchbaseafrica.com/2026/11/03/failed-transfers-hidden-fees-and-phantom-aliases-inside-the-messy-birth-of-west-africas-unified-payments-network/>). On 6 November Wave said [all its customers in Cote d'Ivoire can send and receive through PI-SPI](<https://bifinances.com/actualites/wave-precise-lacces-a-pi-spi-au-senegal-et-en-cote-divoire>), free up to 8,000 FCFA a day. SimoCash, launched in May 2026, [moves funds directly from one mobile money operator to another](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/tech-stars/avec-simocash-l-ivoirien-wilfried-kouame-interconnecte-les-reseaux-d-argent-mobile>). No source found since October 2023 says a national switch connects wallets and bank accounts. Mature would need a national switch in service that connects mobile money wallets and bank accounts.

[Cameroon has two licensed payment institutions, Orange Money Cameroun and Mobile Money Corporation, per DGTCFM data updated July 2026](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-finance/1709-141667-cameroun-konoom-obtient-son-agrement-et-se-lance-sur-le-marche-du-paiement-mobile>). [AfricaNenda says GIMACPAY provides domestic instant payment functionality connecting banks and mobile money wallets in each CEMAC state](<https://www.africanenda.org/uploads/files/SIIPS2023_CaseStudy_CEMAC.pdf>). That includes Cameroon. In the last twelve months, [BEAC says the QR code launched on 29 July 2026 lets any bank or microfinance mobile app read any merchant's code](<https://www.gabonreview.com/cemac-moins-de-cash-plus-de-numerique-la-beac-deploie-le-qr-code-interoperable/>). On 31 August 2026 Tech Africa News reported that [LBPay lets users transfer funds across different mobile money networks](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/08/31/looping-binary-launches-lbpay-digital-payments-cameroon/>). [In November 2026 ITWeb Africa, citing the central bank's latest payment services report, gave 2.73 billion transactions](<https://www.itweb.africa/article/visa-deepens-central-africa-footprint/dgp45MaBAJmqX9l8>).

[In April 2026 Vodacom Congo's CEO said about $88 million had moved into the formal banking sector through wallet-to-bank transfers over the past year](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/4723/vodacom-congo-calls-for-integrated-financial-ecosystem-to-enhance-inclusion-in-drc>). [At 30 June 2024 Orange Money RDC held CDF 6.8bn of receivables from interoperability with Airtel Money and M-Pesa](<https://www.orange.cd/particuliers/resources/other/RAPPORT%20PILIER%20III%20OMRDC_Exercice%20S1%202024%20-%20VF.pdf>). [In May 2026 almost 30 million citizens had a mobile money account, though cash still dominates](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202605/mainmoney-palm-biometrics-platform-to-support-drcs-financial-inclusion-drive>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a national switch connects wallets and bank accounts. Mature would need a national switch in service that connects mobile money wallets and bank accounts.

[The CEMAC QR Code standard was launched on 29 July 2026 across six states including Congo](<https://leconomie.info/article/paiement-numerique-le-gimac-officialise-la-norme-qr-code-interoperable-de-la-cemac>). It lets a client with a bank account, mobile money wallet or microfinance account pay by scan whatever their institution. [AfricaNenda says GIMACPAY also provides domestic instant payment functionality connecting banks and mobile money wallets in each CEMAC state](<https://www.africanenda.org/uploads/files/SIIPS2023_CaseStudy_CEMAC.pdf>). That includes the Republic of Congo. [GIMAC said that in the first half of 2026 payment institutions and mobile money operators, including those of Congo, dominate GIMACPAY transaction volumes](<https://leconomie.info/article/paiements-numeriques-gimacpay-enregistre-203-millions-de-transactions-pour-863-milliards-de-fcfa-en-2025>). No change has been found in the last twelve months.

[The central bank describes Komor Switch as the national payment infrastructure](<https://banque-comores.km/uploads/BCC-livret(3).pdf>). It interconnects all banks, financial institutions and mobile money services. [Al-Watwan reports the president launched Komor Switch, a national platform connecting all banks and mobile money services](<https://alwatwan.net/economie/secteur-bancaire-i-les-comores-inaugurent-de-nouveaux-modes-et-syst%C3%A8mes-de-paiement.html>). [The central bank says Komor Switch allows instant real-time transfers between banks and mobile money](<https://banque-comores.km/uploads/BCC-livret(3).pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months.

[Banco de Cabo Verde's 2025 payment system report counts 50,866 users of televinti4, which puts the vinti4 card on a mobile phone](<https://expressodasilhas.cv/economia/2026/09/25/mais-cabo-verdianos-com-contas-bancarias-e-maior-uso-de-pagamentos-digitais/104797>). They made 1,284,291 transactions moving money in 2025, Expresso das Ilhas reports. [The app was launched in 2021, is run by SISP and carries transfers, QR code payments, bills and phone top-ups](<https://expressodasilhas.cv/economia/2024/03/03/app-coloca-vinti4-no-telemovel-mas-taxa-de-penetracao-continua-baixa/90231>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says payments between providers, or between wallets and banks, are in service. Operating would need payments between different mobile money providers, or between wallets and banks, in service.

[Djibouti Telecom's D-Money launched its new smartphone application on 26 September 2024](<https://d-money.dj/lancement-de-la-nouvelle-plateforme-d-money/>). [Open to all Djiboutians since 21 September, it serves money transfers, bill payment and online purchases of services](<https://d-money.dj/lancement-de-la-nouvelle-plateforme-d-money/>). [In November 2020 the Ministry of Communication said D-Money, then recently launched, already had thousands of subscribers, three ministers among them](<https://communication.gouv.dj/d-money-mcpt-le-ministre-de-la-communication-lance-officiellement-le-nouveau-systeme-service-digital-mobile-money-appele-d-money/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says payments between providers, or between wallets and banks, are in service. Operating would need payments between different mobile money providers, or between wallets and banks, in service.

[Interbank mobile payment, DZ Mob Pay, launched in January 2025](<https://algerie-eco.com/2026/02/18/algerie-le-montant-des-paiements-electroniques-sest-eleve-a-939-milliards-de-dinars-en-2025-46/>). [A national mobile switch has been in service since June 2024](<https://alger16.dz/?p=65795>). In the last twelve months, [the post ministry said the mobile switch lets clients of the banks and of Algerie Poste pay and transfer money instantly by QR code](<https://www.mpt.gov.dz/achievements/>). [GIE Monetique's director says the banks' mobile solutions are integrated into it](<https://www.elmoudjahid.dz/fr/economie/assia-benchabla-queiroz-directrice-du-gie-de-nombreux-obstacles-entravent-le-paiement-electronique-en-algerie-236510>). [By the end of August 2026 it had 131,705 personal and 18,730 merchant accounts, per GIE Monetique data](<https://ecotimesdz.com/numerique-algerie-efficacite-services-care/>).

[The Central Bank of Egypt's deputy governor said mobile wallets numbered about 67 million by September 2026](<https://www.businesstodayegypt.com/Article/1/8078/Egypt%E2%80%99s-financial-inclusion-rate-rises-to-79-in-June-2026>). [InstaPay, the instant payments network launched in March 2022, carries personal, commercial and account-to-wallet transfers](<https://www.elwatannews.com/news/details/8325979>). [Ahram Online describes InstaPay as a state-backed payment app licensed by the Central Bank of Egypt](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/News/576342.aspx>). [Orange Egypt says its Orange Cash wallet had about 10 million users in October 2026](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/10/20/orange-egypt-botim-uae-egypt-remittances/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months.

[Himbol's terms of service, in force from November 2025, describe its M-Nakfa mobile money wallet](<https://erihimbol.com/assets/Himbol%20-%20Terms%20and%20Conditions%20of%20Service-DOgGzzwW.pdf>). It carries cash-in and cash-out, transfers between people, merchant payments and utility bills, under Bank of Eritrea oversight. [The Fintech Times said in 2026 that wallets linked to the state-owned EriTel are the main entry point to digital financial services](<https://thefintechtimes.com/eritreas-fintech-ecosystem-in-2026-and-financial-inclusion/>). It called their functions still limited. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says payments between providers, or between wallets and banks, are in service. Operating would need payments between different mobile money providers, or between wallets and banks, in service.

[In November 2026 EthSwitch's EthioPay carried interoperable person-to-person payments across 51 institutions and QR payments across 40](<https://digitaleconomymag.com/2026/11/ethswitch-calls-for-merchant-trust-to-scale-instant-payments-in-africa/>). [Capital describes EthSwitch as Ethiopia's national payment switch linking banks, payment-service providers, merchants and the mobile-money platforms](<https://capitalethiopia.com/2026/10/04/mobile-money-wallets-set-to-link-with-papss-opening-access-to-african-markets/>). [Capital says telebirr and M-Pesa are both connected through EthSwitch, which provides interoperability linking banks, payment-service providers and merchants](<https://capitalethiopia.com/2026/10/04/mobile-money-wallets-set-to-link-with-papss-opening-access-to-african-markets/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months.

[The CEMAC QR Code standard was launched on 29 July 2026 across six states including Gabon](<https://leconomie.info/article/paiement-numerique-le-gimac-officialise-la-norme-qr-code-interoperable-de-la-cemac>). It lets a client with a bank account, mobile money wallet or microfinance account pay by scan whatever their institution. [AfricaNenda says GIMACPAY also provides domestic instant payment functionality connecting banks and mobile money wallets in each CEMAC state](<https://www.africanenda.org/uploads/files/SIIPS2023_CaseStudy_CEMAC.pdf>). That includes Gabon. [Moov Gabon issued 1,969,325 transactions worth 68.1bn FCFA and Airtel Gabon 1,950,401 worth 55.8bn FCFA in H1 2026, per GIMAC statistics](<https://leconomie.info/article/monetique-moov-gabon-devient-le-premier-emetteur-de-paiements-electroniques-de-la-cemac>). No change has been found in the last twelve months.

The Bank of Ghana [counted 85.8 million registered mobile money accounts in August 2026](<https://www.bog.gov.gh/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Summary-of-Economic-and-Financial-Data-September-2026.pdf>), 26.4 million of them active. GhIPSS links banks and mobile money operators. In the last twelve months, in October 2026, the Bank of Ghana's head of fintech [called it the national interoperable payment infrastructure](<https://channelonenewsonline.com/2026/10/22/bank-of-ghana-pushes-for-seamless-african-cross-border-payments/>). [The Bank of Ghana reports mobile money interoperability in August 2026 at 35.7 million transactions worth GHC 6.5 billion](<https://www.bog.gov.gh/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Summary-of-Economic-and-Financial-Data-September-2026.pdf>). Nothing on the three questions is missing.

[NimbaPay went live on 23 July 2026, linking banks and electronic money institutions](<https://www.itnewsafrica.com/2026/07/guinea-launches-nimbapay-opening-a-new-era-of-instant-and-inclusive-digital-payments/>). [AGUIDUTEN described NimbaPay as the national instant payment platform](<https://focusguinee.info/2026/07/26/laguiduten-salue-le-lancement-de-nimbapay-la-plateforme-nationale-de-paiement-instantane/>). It connects banks, e-money institutions and microfinance institutions. [The BCRG's supervision director general cited NimbaPay as a platform ensuring interoperability between banks, e-money institutions and microfinance institutions](<https://mediaguinee.com/2026/07/paiements-digitaux-ofmg-la-cciag-et-la-bcrg-engagent-une-demarche-pour-encourager-les-transactions-electroniques-en-guinee/>). In the last twelve months, by 15 October 2026, [seven institutions were connected to NimbaPay, which had carried about 67,000 transactions worth over GNF 68 billion](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites/2610-142742-guinee-nimbapay-traite-7-6-millions-de-transactions-et-connecte-7-etablissements-en-4-mois>).

[Gamswitch called BANTABA 2.0 the country's first real-time, fully interoperable payment system in February 2026](<https://www.gamswitch.com/press-release/the-gambia-launches-national-payment-systems-advisory-committee-npsac-to-strengthen-payment-system-governance>). [The Point calls BANTABA 2.0 a national backbone run by Gamswitch](<https://thepoint.gm/africa/gambia/headlines/gambia-launches-bantaba-2-0-first-real-time-interoperable-payment-system>). [One switch connects banks, mobile money operators, microfinance institutions, fintechs and payment providers](<https://www.gamswitch.com/press-release/the-gambia-launches-bantaba-2-0-its-first-real-time-interoperable-payment-system>). In the last twelve months, [since its launch in December 2025 it has moved money instantly between bank accounts and mobile wallets, whatever the provider](<https://www.gamswitch.com/press-release/the-gambia-launches-bantaba-2-0-its-first-real-time-interoperable-payment-system>).

[On 30 September 2026 the BCEAO listed Orange Money Guinea-Bissau among 7 institutions in Guinea-Bissau authorised to open PI-SPI services to the public](<https://www.bceao.int/sites/default/files/inline-files/Liste%20des%20participants_PI-SPI_30_sept_2026_0.pdf>). [In September 2026 the BCEAO said interoperable e-money transactions in UEMOA, which includes Guinea-Bissau, go through PI-SPI](<https://www.forbesafrica.com/current-affairs/2026/10/07/interoperability-not-truly-free-fintech-experts-on-west-africas-instant-payments-rollout>). In the last twelve months, [Guinea-Bissau had 5 institutions authorised on PI-SPI at 31 July 2026](<https://financesao.com/uemoa-pi-spi-atteint-104-etablissements-autorises/>), and 7 by 30 September. No source found since October 2023 says a national switch connects wallets and bank accounts. Mature would need a national switch in service that connects mobile money wallets and bank accounts.

[The CEMAC QR Code standard was launched on 29 July 2026 across six states including Equatorial Guinea](<https://leconomie.info/article/paiement-numerique-le-gimac-officialise-la-norme-qr-code-interoperable-de-la-cemac>). It lets a client with a bank account, mobile money wallet or microfinance account pay by scan whatever their institution. [AfricaNenda says GIMACPAY also provides domestic instant payment functionality connecting banks and mobile money wallets in each CEMAC state](<https://www.africanenda.org/uploads/files/SIIPS2023_CaseStudy_CEMAC.pdf>). That includes Equatorial Guinea. [GIMACPAY, the CEMAC card-mobile-transfer ecosystem in service since 2021, processed over sixteen million mobile transactions in 2025](<https://leconomie.info/article/paiement-numerique-le-gimac-officialise-la-norme-qr-code-interoperable-de-la-cemac>). No change has been found in the last twelve months.

[Kenswitch calls itself Kenya's domestic payment switch](<https://www.business-standard.com/content/press-releases-ani/kenswitch-partners-with-payu-s-wibmo-to-strengthen-online-card-security-in-kenya-126110200460_1.html>). [In November 2026 Kenswitch said it links banks, SACCOs, microfinance institutions and mobile money providers](<https://www.business-standard.com/content/press-releases-ani/kenswitch-partners-with-payu-s-wibmo-to-strengthen-online-card-security-in-kenya-126110200460_1.html>). [Transfers between M-PESA, banks and other wallets such as Airtel Money pass through several platforms](<https://techcabal.com/2026/03/20/m-pesa-to-stop-sharing-full-phone-numbers-with-merchants-banks-by-end-of-2026/>). In the last twelve months, on 10 November 2026, Airtel Kenya and IPSL [agreed to let Airtel Money users send money to accounts at 30 banks, SACCOs and microfinance banks on Pesalink](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/11/11/airtel-kenya-pesalink-money-transfers-30-financial-institutions/>). IPSL's chief said [Pesalink reaches all banks and has begun till, paybill and QR payments to merchants](<https://techcabal.com/2026/11/19/pesalink-kenya-on-cheaper-payments/>). No source says one national switch connects all wallets and bank accounts. Mature would need one national switch in service that connects mobile money wallets and bank accounts.

[The Central Bank of Liberia launched the Inclusive Instant Payment System on 16 December 2025](<https://cbl.org.lr/index.php/media/features-articles/special-remark-executive-governor-henry-f-saamoi-launch-iips-december-16>). [It had carried more than 5.3 million transactions since launch](<https://www.liberianobserver.com/business/liberia-s-instant-payment-system-crosses-5-3m-transactions/article_b75bc316-97ae-459f-840d-c2822b8e7a84.html>). In the last twelve months, [in August 2026 the deputy governor said the system enables payments across banks and mobile network operators](<https://www.liberianobserver.com/business/cbl-backs-lra-s-move-to-billion-revenue-drive/article_7ef5e649-7ccd-4187-91bc-d17d1a19505c.html>). In November 2026 the governor said [banks and fintechs were still being brought onto Pay Na-Na](<https://www.liberianobserver.com/business/cbl-outlines-four-priorities-to-transform-liberia-s-digital-payment-system/article_39f669bb-c385-4c6e-a854-e9f6581fc1e6.html>). [A National Electronic Payment Switch joining banks, fintechs and mobile money operators is targeted for early 2027](<https://www.liberianobserver.com/business/cbl-governor-highlights-liberia-s-digital-payment-gains-in-mauritius/article_596d456e-3fae-4d52-bf5d-b592db44f2d3.html>). Mature would need a national switch in service that connects mobile money wallets and bank accounts.

[Digital-wallet transactions rose from 109 million dinars in October 2024 to 703 million in August 2026, the governor said](<https://libyaherald.com/2026/09/cbl-governor-issa-launches-several-initiatives-and-reviews-achievements-at-tripoli-arab-savings-and-financial-literacy-conference>). [In January and February 2026 Libya had 187,335 electronic wallets and 6,096 acceptance points](<https://alwasat.ly/news/libya/510123>). [Over the same months the instant payment services LYPay and OnePay carried more than 44.6 billion dinars](<https://alwasat.ly/news/libya/510123>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says payments between providers, or between wallets and banks, are in service. Operating would need payments between different mobile money providers, or between wallets and banks, in service.

[In May 2025 LeSwitch, formerly the National Payment Switch, connected banks and mobile money wallets](<https://publiceyenews.com/2025/05/20/leswitch-expands-to-pos-transactions>). [LeSwitch fast payments, launched on 20 March 2024, give digital interoperability between banks and non-bank entities](<https://www.standardlesothobank.co.ls/lesotho/personal/About-us/press-releases/press-release-lesotho-national-payment-switch-leswitch>). [In July 2026 Vodacom Lesotho said M-Pesa customers across urban, peri-urban and rural Lesotho use their mobile wallets](<https://www.connectingafrica.com/fintech/vodacom-lesotho-launches-m-pesa-investment-solution>). [It now carries local ATM and POS debit card transactions, with POS in pilot from 11 May 2025](<https://publiceyenews.com/2025/05/20/leswitch-expands-to-pos-transactions>). No change has been found in the last twelve months.
